services.desc: Ready for a perfect day out on the green? Find fairways and fair days at this premiere golf course in Acworth, Georgia! Experience the beauty of the Lake City at one of the most popular public courses in North Atlanta. While coming in on par isn’t guaranteed, the scenic views of Lake Acworth at Cobblestone Golf Course create an experience worth writing home about. This nationally recognized 4-star public course has golfers of all skill levels returning again and again. Make your day even more memorable by checking out Acworth’s charming historic downtown after tee-time. blurb: Save Acworth History Foundation is a 501(c)(3) organization dedicated to preserving and promoting the history of our city and the community of Acworth, GA. Our goal is to collect video histories, photos and artifacts that reflect our history as a railroad town, a mill town, and the center of an agricultural community. These will be displayed and available daily in the downtown Depot Park History Center.
